bio: This centuries-old farmhouse with a timber façade exudes a rustic charm that has also been preserved inside. Here in the cosy and quaint converted Hofkücherl, diners tuck into the ambitious modern cuisine of Manuela Holzbauer and chef-patron Manuel Faltermeier. This revolves around Bavaria and the seasons and is served in the form of the three- to six-course Frühlingserwachen Menü (conventional or vegetarian), which changes every three weeks, and the four-course R90 set menu, made entirely with ingredients from within a 90km radius. The sustainable philosophy is evident in the choice of produce.
